title: List entries are bounded by the fold maximum
statement: Let $s$ be a list of natural numbers and let $n$ be a member of $s$. Then $n$ is at most the right fold of maximum over $s$, with initial value $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a list of natural numbers
replaced:
For every list $s$ of natural numbers and every member $n$ of $s$, $n$ is at most the
maximum of $s$, computed as the right fold of $\max$ with initial value $0$.
